title: Enfamil Infant, powder, made with baby water

content.title: About
content.content: Enfamil Infant is a powdered infant formula designed for babies from birth to 12 months. It provides all essential nutrients—including proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals—and is prepared with specially treated baby water (336 ml) for optimal dissolution.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The formula is enriched with DHA and ARA, fatty acids important for brain and eye development.
Contains the prebiotic GOS to support a healthy gut microbiome.
Manufactured under ISO 22000 international quality standards.
Each package includes precise preparation instructions with exact water‑to‑powder ratios.
Clinically tested to confirm safety and efficacy for infants.

items.title: Supports growth and development
items.content: A balanced blend of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates supplies energy and building blocks for the growing body.

items.title: Brain development
items.content: DHA and ARA aid in forming neural connections and visual function.

items.title: Gut health
items.content: The prebiotic GOS promotes beneficial bacteria, improving digestion.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamins A, C, D and zinc help maintain the immune system.

items.title: Optimal hydration
items.content: Specially treated baby water provides the right electrolyte balance.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Infants with known cow‑milk protein allergy may react to the formula.

items.title: Incorrect reconstitution
items.content: Too concentrated or too diluted a mixture can lead to dehydration or excess calorie intake.

items.title: Post‑opening storage
items.content: Powder can absorb moisture, causing clumping and loss of quality.

items.title: Shelf life
items.content: Use before the printed expiration date; nutrient quality may decline afterward.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Mix the specified amount of powder with 336 ml of warm (not hot) baby water. Stir thoroughly until smooth, let it cool to body temperature, and feed the baby immediately.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the container tightly sealed in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, use within 30 days and follow the storage guidelines on the label.
